definitions.explanation: An object or arrangement used to make something look more attractive.

examples.japanese: クリスマスの{飾|かざ}りを{出|だ}した。
examples.english: I took out the Christmas decorations.

examples.japanese: {部屋|へや}に{花|はな}の{飾|かざ}りがある。
examples.english: There is a flower decoration in the room.

examples.japanese: お{正月|しょうがつ}の{飾|かざ}りを{買|か}いに{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to buy New Year decorations.

notes:
{飾|かざ}り is a noun meaning decoration or ornament. It comes from the verb {飾|かざ}る (to decorate).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {飾|かざ}りをつける (to put up decorations)
- {飾|かざ}りを{外|はず}す (to take down decorations)
- {飾|かざ}り{棚|だな} (display shelf)
- {飾|かざ}り{窓|まど} (display window)

COMPOUND WORDS:
- {髪飾|かみかざ}り (hair ornament)
- {首飾|くびかざ}り (necklace)
- {正月飾|しょうがつかざ}り (New Year decorations)

RELATED VERB:
- {飾|かざ}る (to decorate, to display)
